text: attato . na saññaṃ . na saṅkhāre . na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā viññāṇaṃ na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ . ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti . iti hidaṃ bhikkhave vuccati dukkhanirodhagāminī samanupassanāti ayamevettha atthoti . [91] sāvatthiyaṃ . tatra kho . rūpaṃ bhikkhave aniccaṃ yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadanattā yadanattā taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi
